# Independent Education

> Independent Education is a study abroad consultancy in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It gives Bangladeshi students free counselling on choosing a country, course and university, applying, scholarships, IELTS and other English tests, student visas and preparing to move abroad.

- Website: https://www.your-domain.com/
- Office: 89/2 Siraj Tower, New Airport Road, Kakoli, Banani, Dhaka 1213, Bangladesh
- Office hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Bangladesh time)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +8801913179498, +8801757637744, +8801793033747, +8801553369322
- Email: info.independentedu@gmail.com
- Counselling is free of charge. University application fees, test fees and visa fees are paid to those organisations directly.

## Study destinations

Australia, United Kingdom, Canada, USA, New Zealand, Ireland, Europe, South Korea, Malaysia, Türkiye and China. The university finder also lists universities in Colombia and China.

## Main pages

- [Study abroad steps](https://www.your-domain.com/study-abroad-steps.html): why study abroad, choosing where and what to study, applying, after the offer, preparing to leave and arriving
- [Study destinations](https://www.your-domain.com/destinations.html): intakes, English tests and work rights by country
- [Find a university](https://www.your-domain.com/find-a-university.html): searchable list of universities, colleges and institutes
- [Find a scholarship](https://www.your-domain.com/scholarships.html): government and university scholarships open to Bangladeshi students
- [How to apply](https://www.your-domain.com/how-to-apply.html): application steps and a document checklist
- [IELTS](https://www.your-domain.com/ielts.html): test types, format, scoring and preparation
- [Student essentials](https://www.your-domain.com/student-essentials.html): education loans, health insurance, money transfer, accommodation, banking, guardianship, SIM cards and student ID cards
- [Courses](https://www.your-domain.com/courses.html): course advice, university finder and subject guide
- [Book an appointment](https://www.your-domain.com/booking.html): choose a day and time for free counselling
- [Apply online](https://www.your-domain.com/apply.html): online university application form with document upload
- [Student portal](https://www.your-domain.com/portal.html): students who have applied can check their application status, read messages and upload documents
- [Events](https://www.your-domain.com/events.html): seminars and information sessions
- [Services](https://www.your-domain.com/services.html): what the counsellors help with
- [FAQ](https://www.your-domain.com/faq.html)
- [Contact](https://www.your-domain.com/contact.html)

## Notes

The university list shows examples to help students start their search. It is not a ranking and not a list of partner institutions. Visa, work and scholarship rules change often, so students should confirm the latest official information.
